title: Clear Pumpkin
body:
**Clear Pumpkin** reduces the carved pumpkin screen overlay, giving you a clean and unobstructed view while wearing a pumpkin.

This is perfect for exploring **The End**, walking through **Warped Forests** or staying safe around Endermen without having your screen covered by the default pumpkin blur.

## Features

- Reduces the carved pumpkin overlay
- Makes Enderman safe exploration much easier
- Works great in The End and Warped Forests
- Lightweight and simple
- Vanilla friendly

## Why use it?

Normally, wearing a carved pumpkin protects you from angering Endermen, but the dark overlay makes it hard to see. **Clear Pumpkin** fixes that by keeping your screen clear while still letting you use the pumpkin normally.

## Compatibility

This pack only changes the pumpkin overlay texture, so it should work with most other resource packs. Place **Clear Pumpkin** above other packs if another pack also changes the pumpkin overlay.
